# Victor Vieux

> Personal site of Victor Vieux, a French software engineer living in San Francisco. Posts cover software engineering, AI-assisted development, and personal projects.

Blog posts are available as static HTML. The resume has an explicit plain-text version.

## Profile

- [Homepage](https://vieux.fr/): Biography, work history, projects, and social profiles.
- [Resume](https://cv.vieux.fr/resume.txt): Plain-text professional resume.

## Blog posts

- [Local Voice Routines with an Old Amazon Echo Dot and Home Assistant](https://vieux.fr/wake-word-echo-dot/): Repurposing Echo Dots with EchoLocal and custom wake word models to trigger Home Assistant routines.
- [Rewriting My Expo App in Native Kotlin](https://vieux.fr/cocktailsnap-native/): Rewriting CocktailSnap from Expo and React Native to native Kotlin and submitting it to Google Play in four hours.
- [Restoring My 2007 Qt Apps With Codex](https://vieux.fr/qt2007/): Restoring two undocumented Qt applications from 2007 on an Apple Silicon Mac.
- [Building DamN64: LLM-Assisted N64 Development](https://vieux.fr/damn64/): Building an isometric, two-player Nintendo 64 game with LLM-assisted development.
